name: @qu/push
description: Dependency-free Web Push (RFC 8291 payload encryption + RFC 8292 VAPID auth) using only node:crypto - the relay's side of browser push notifications. Ported conceptually from QUniverse V1's relay/webpush.mjs (see that file's history for why hand-rolling this beats a dependency: it's a small, stable, fully-specified RFC, and the relay already treats every OTHER signature/encryption primitive as core infrastructure, not something to outsource).
